steps.title: A page made of named parts
steps.titleZh: 用有含义的标签搭起来的页面
steps.text: This made-up field notebook is built from elements that say what each part is for: `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<article>`, `<aside>` and `<footer>`. The readout counts each one; the page itself has no `<div>` at all. Screen readers can list the big parts of a page, called landmarks, such as the navigation, the main content and a side note, and jump straight to one. This guide panel is an `<aside>` too: related content that is not part of the article.
steps.textZh: 这本虚构的野外笔记，是用能说明每一部分用途的元素搭起来的：`<header>`、`<nav>`、`<main>`、`<article>`、`<aside>` 和 `<footer>`。下面的读数数出了每种元素各有几个；页面本身一个 `<div>` 都没有。屏幕阅读器可以把页面的几大块列出来，这些大块叫作地标（landmark），比如导航、主要内容和旁注，读者可以直接跳到其中一块。这个说明面板本身也是一个 `<aside>`：它是相关内容，但不属于文章。

watch.label: elements outside this guide
watch.expect: header 1, nav 1, main 1, article 1, section 1, aside 1, footer 2, div 0

steps.title: The header and the navigation
steps.text: `<header>` holds the page title, the only `<h1>`, and one line of introduction. `<nav>` holds the links that move around the page, and its `aria-label` gives it the name `Notebook` for screen readers. Follow the first link: the address now ends in `#entry`, the `id` of the article.
steps.textZh: `<header>` 放页面标题（页面上唯一的 `<h1>`）和一行介绍。`<nav>` 放在页面内跳转的链接，它的 `aria-label` 给这组导航起名为「笔记」，供屏幕阅读器使用。点一下第一个链接：地址会以 `#entry` 结尾，这正是文章的 `id`。

steps.title: The main content and one article
steps.text: `<main>` holds what the page is about. Inside it, the `<article>` is a piece that makes sense on its own, like a blog post: a `<section>` groups one topic, and the article's own `<footer>` gives the date. `<time datetime="2026-09-28">` shows people one text and gives programs the same date in a fixed format.
steps.textZh: `<main>` 放页面的主要内容。它里面的 `<article>` 是一段可以独立成立的内容，就像一篇博客文章：`<section>` 归拢一个主题，文章自己的 `<footer>` 给出发布日期。`<time datetime="2026-09-28">` 给人看的是一段文字，同时用固定的格式把同一个日期提供给程序。

action.run: const time = document.querySelector('time'); console.log('people read:', time.textContent); console.log('programs read:', time.dateTime)

steps.title: A side note, and this guide
steps.titleZh: 一段旁注，还有这个面板
steps.text: `<aside>` holds related content that is not part of the article: here, the note about the notebook. This guide panel is an `<aside>` too, so the page now has two. Follow the second link: the address ends in `#author`, the note's `id`.
steps.textZh: `<aside>` 放与文章相关、但不属于文章的内容，这里是那段关于笔记的说明。这个说明面板也是一个 `<aside>`，所以页面上现在有两个。点一下第二个链接：地址会以 `#author` 结尾，也就是那段说明的 `id`。

steps.title: The page footer and the headings
steps.text: A last `<footer>` closes the page. The headings go down one level at a time: `<h1>` for the page, `<h2>` for the article and the note, `<h3>` for the section inside the article. People who use screen readers often jump from heading to heading, and a skipped level leaves them wondering what is missing. This button lists the headings, indented by level.
steps.textZh: 最后一个 `<footer>` 作为整个页面的结尾。标题每次只往下降一级：页面用 `<h1>`，文章和说明用 `<h2>`，文章里的小节用 `<h3>`。使用屏幕阅读器的人常常从一个标题跳到下一个标题；如果跳过了某一级，他们会纳闷缺掉的那个标题去了哪里。这个按钮按级别缩进，列出所有标题。

action.run: for (const heading of document.querySelectorAll('h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6')) console.log('  '.repeat(Number(heading.localName[1]) - 1) + heading.localName + ' ' + heading.textContent)
